title: EmailSubmission/set: BackendSetError::Other mapped to notFound instead of server error
description: submission.rs:319-326 (destroy) and submission.rs:379-386 (onSuccessUpdateEmail update): BackendSetError::Other(e) is inserted into not_destroyed/not_updated with SetErrorType::NotFound. A storage failure (disk full, DB error, etc.) will be reported to the client as 'the object was not found'. The Email/set handler correctly uses json\!({"type": "serverFail", ...}) for this case (email.rs:444, 488, 520). Fix: use json\!({"type": "serverFail", "description": e.to_string()}) consistently.
